description: Mirror each finished turn into clipboard.md's inbox, so a reply the agent didn't explicitly send through a tool is still visible.

hooks._comment: The guard is load-bearing. Installing this plugin enables it GLOBALLY, so this hook fires at the end of every turn in every Claude Code session on the machine — not only the ones clipboard.md spawned. CLIPMD_HOOK_NODE and CLIPMD_SESSION_KEY are injected into our sessions' environment only (agents.ts sessionEnv), so everywhere else the command expanded to `"" "...mirror-turn.mjs"`, which the shell reports as `: Permission denied` (exit 127) on every single turn of the user's unrelated sessions. Foreign sessions must be a silent no-op.
